value.rationale: Sharp minimum sketch size b=3 determines when uniform expected squared rank-one LU approximation error is mathematically possible; exact e^-1/log divergence below threshold gives nontrivial implementation-relevant boundary. Higher-than-second moment and sharp T^-2 tail failure even for SPD condition numbers <=2 exposes a substantive concentration limitation absent from expectation analyses. The facts are motivated by actual Gaussian-sketch pivot algorithm and feature-preserving approximation, and are not a textbook algebraic normalization check.
